run_object_detection_benchmark: run the object detection benchmark script with a config file and optional evaluation-only flag
build_roi_heads_extra_norm: build a custom Res5ROIHeads class with an extra batch normalization layer after the res5 stage
build_detection_evaluator: build a COCO or Pascal VOC detection evaluator based on the dataset name from config
test_object_detection_model: test an object detection model by loading weights and running inference evaluation
train_object_detection_model: train an object detection model using the custom Trainer class with res5 extra norm support
